score_scale.0: Failed stop gate or no admissible evidence.
score_scale.1: Speculative evidence with a critical blocker.
score_scale.2: Partial evidence with important unresolved gaps.
score_scale.3: Reproduced feasibility evidence with bounded open work.
score_scale.4: Reproduced evidence that meets the applicable sprint gates.
score_scale.5: Independent audit and operational evidence exceed the gates.

eligibility.moriarty-language: WP01 through WP11 pass, including the WP09 safety spine and two external pilots.
eligibility.audited-compact-libraries: The pinned library baseline passes safety, proof, cost, audit, and client-verification gates.
eligibility.stop: Always eligible. Mandatory after a global safety veto or when neither build option is eligible.

global_safety_vetoes: A reproducible conservation or authorization violation remains.
An unintended or substituted transaction reaches signing.
A critical or high audit finding remains open.
No supported real proof path exists for either build option.
selection_order: Select stop when no build alternative remains.
Select Moriarty only when its weighted score exceeds libraries by at least 0.5.
tie_rule: Select audited Compact libraries when eligible weighted scores differ by less than 0.5.
abstention_rule: An abstention contributes no score and no approval. It preserves its evidence gap.

sol.accepted_terminal_evidence: OpenAI Codex terminal banner reports model: gpt-5.6-sol

signing.authority: Moriarty decision authority named in the record
